answer: Each identity is one vertex on a spiral ledger, seeded with a $25 stake; entry order sets position, only inner rings vote. Each epoch a rotated raven auditor lands on three vertices and demands a live-response heartbeat within 12 minutes. One miss folds your vertex outward, slashing 25% of the stake; a second miss burns it into a community pool. Forging 1,000 Sybil IDs locks $25,000 in stakes and needs 1,000 live endpoints answering every epoch inside a 12-minute window — about $35,000 a month in hosting before the first forged vote. Like a murder of ravens: a fake bird cannot caw on cue.
